marketBrief.headline: Tech-led gains keep Fed and earnings in focus
marketBrief.summary: U.S. stocks finished higher Tuesday, with technology and semiconductor shares leading; the Dow's smaller gain reflected weakness in Boeing. Investors turn next to Wednesday's Federal Reserve decision and Alphabet and Microsoft's earnings after the close. Close levels are drawn from Schwab's dated market recap, with Yahoo Finance and Investopedia providing corroboration on market direction and movers.
bullets: Yahoo Finance's close report described Nasdaq Composite up about 1.1% and S&P 500 up 0.6%; distinguish the Composite from Nasdaq 100 levels.
Technology and chip stocks led; Boeing's decline restrained the Dow, according to Investopedia's market coverage.
Visa's fiscal Q4 and full-year results were scheduled for Oct. 27; no unverified after-market result is reported here.
Wednesday brings the Federal Reserve decision and after-close Alphabet and Microsoft earnings; BEA schedules Q3 GDP and September income/outlays Thursday at 8:30 a.m. ET.
